prompt: Our oldest grey horse still runs (much / fast) than the young horses.
explanation_ru: Для значительного усиления сравнительной степени наречия fast используется модификатор much: much faster.

prompt: Alicja said the nine-year-old's biscuits looked (far / neat) than the adults' tray.
explanation_ru: Слово far ставится перед сравнительной степенью neater, чтобы подчеркнуть большую разницу.

prompt: My new toaster doesn't work (any / well) than Granddad's scratched old one.
explanation_ru: В отрицательных предложениях сравнительная степень наречия well (better) усиливается словом any.

prompt: Fresh snow made this weekend (easily / busy) one in the mountain lodge's history.
explanation_ru: Модификатор easily стоит перед превосходной степенью с артиклем the (easily the busiest), подчёркивая явное лидерство.

prompt: Our class wasted (a lot / little) food than any other group at lunch.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным food форма little переходит в less, а a lot усиливает разницу: a lot less.

prompt: Rodrigo says this burger stall sells out (even / quickly) in rain and is by far (popular) stop on the street.
explanation_ru: После even ставится сравнительная степень наречия (more quickly), а после by far — превосходная степень с артиклем the (the most popular).

prompt: I am pleased to announce that our new kitchen helper cleared the lunch trays (a bit / early) than our previous record.
explanation_ru: Небольшую разницу перед сравнительной степенью наречия early передаёт модификатор a bit: a bit earlier.

prompt: Did you see that Paul's garden now has (second / wide) water-lily leaf in the whole country?
explanation_ru: Для обозначения второго места по признаку перед превосходной степенью ставится the second(-): the second-widest.

prompt: Urs reported that the green tram arrived on time (slightly / often) than before and reached easily (high) score in Basel.
explanation_ru: Slightly смягчает сравнительную степень наречия (more often), а easily требует превосходной степени с артиклем the (the highest).

prompt: Yuki's park isn't usually warm in April, yet the cherry trees bloomed (still / early) than the old fifty-year record.
explanation_ru: Слово still перед сравнительной степенью (still earlier) переводится как «ещё раньше» и усиливает контраст с рекордом.

prompt: Wait — didn't Owen's team answer customer calls (much / fast) than Halifax to win the prize?
explanation_ru: В вопросе со сравнительной степенью наречия fast используется усилитель much, который всегда ставится перед faster.

prompt: After months of gentle cleaning, Layla confirmed that the rolled town map is (third / old) complete drawing in the archive and (considerably / clear) than any copy made later.
explanation_ru: Порядковое числительное с превосходной степенью образует the third-oldest, а в более формальном стиле для усиления сравнительной степени используется considerably clearer.

prompt: Even though a sudden snowstorm delayed the morning buses, this year's chemistry students performed (far / well) than anyone predicted and achieved by far (strong) pass rate in forty years.
explanation_ru: Наречие well имеет неправильную сравнительную степень better (far better), а конструкция by far в группе из многих лет требует превосходной степени the strongest.

prompt: Malcolm wrote that the new car-park camera caught (significantly / many) late drivers than the old attendant, making Saturday easily (expensive) market day the council van had ever had.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным drivers форма many меняется на more (significantly more), а после easily ставится превосходная степень the most expensive.

prompt: I drove the yellow book van through the rain on Saturday. People borrowed (even / many) picture books than usual. It was by far (good) day of our month.
explanation_ru: Слово even усиливает сравнительную форму many → more (even more), а после by far ставится превосходная степень good → the best.

prompt: Amy's charity shop held its autumn coat sale on Saturday. The warm jackets didn't stay on the rails (any / long) than two hours. By closing time, the shop had raised by far (big) sum of the year. Every volunteer left smiling.
explanation_ru: В отрицании длительность передаётся через any longer, а для рекорда за весь год после by far требуется превосходная степень the biggest.

prompt: Jack's dairy farm put solar panels on its barn roof last winter. During sunny February, the panels produced (considerably / clean) power than the old system. They also ran (still / quietly) than the noisy petrol unit. Across the valley, it became easily (large) energy surplus of the season.
explanation_ru: В тексте различаются усиление прилагательного (considerably cleaner), наречия на -ly (still more quietly) и превосходной степени после easily (the largest).

prompt: Sanna watched her young runner step onto the ice with borrowed laces. She wasn't nervous at all, and her turns looked (slightly / smooth) than in practice. On the final jump, she skated even (calmly) than the older girls. In the end, she scored by far (high) marks of the whole youth cup.
explanation_ru: Slightly и even сочетаются со сравнительной степенью (smoother, more calmly), тогда как by far требует превосходной степени с the (the highest).

prompt: Have you tried Samuel's new farm-delivery app in Nairobi yet? Since they added voice notes, placing an order takes much (little / time) than typing every item. Farmers also get paid a bit (quickly) than at the crowded street stalls. That is why it is now (second / large) shopping tool in the region.
explanation_ru: После much и a bit идут сравнительные формы (less time, more quickly), а для второго места в регионе используется the second-largest.

prompt: Valeria sent out a press note after the paper-sculpture festival closed in Mexico City. Although rain threatened on Sunday morning, families queued (significantly / patiently) than staff had feared. By afternoon, the garden was far (crowded) than during last year's show, turning the weekend into (easily / big) event in the museum's history.
explanation_ru: Significantly и far усиливают сравнительные формы (more patiently, more crowded), а рекорд за всю историю музея передаётся через easily the biggest.

prompt: In my seasonal airport report, the northern lights clearly drove our winter numbers up. Flights weren't cancelled nearly as often, so passengers moved through security much (smoothly) than the year before. Charter bookings grew even (strongly) in January, making this by far (successful) winter the terminal has ever seen.
explanation_ru: После much и even глаголы требуют сравнительной степени наречий (more smoothly, more strongly), а после by far стоит превосходная степень прилагательного the most successful.

prompt: Salma spent four months unrolling a fragile harbour list at the archive in Alexandria. She brushed the dry paper far (carefully) than an amateur would, and the old ink turned out a great deal (easy) to read than on similar rolls. Her find is now (third / old) intact shipping record in the entire collection.
explanation_ru: Far и a great deal сочетаются со сравнительной степенью (наречие more carefully и прилагательное easier), а порядковый рейтинг строится как the third-oldest.

prompt: When Remo shakes carrots, the old donkey runs ___ than the young horses.
explanation_ru: Слово very нельзя ставить перед сравнительной степенью (вместо very faster нужно much faster), а more faster — двойное сравнение.

prompt: Grant joked that Mum's green kettle is ___ phone in our kitchen.
explanation_ru: Для усиления превосходной степени используется by far + the + -est; варианты the more strongest и very the strongest грамматически неверны.

prompt: Trevor's autumn street dinner welcomed ___ crowd the neighbourhood had ever seen.
explanation_ru: Перед превосходной степенью с артиклем the ставится усилитель easily (easily the biggest), но не very и не сравнительная степень.

prompt: Nobody expected Yuna's late-night comedy to do ___ than the big weekend dramas.
explanation_ru: Сравнительную степень better усиливают через a lot, much или far, но не через very и не с лишним словом more.

prompt: Since Juma started using the spoken fruit list, checking daily market prices has become ___ for every stallholder in our row.
options: by far easier and more fast
explanation_ru: Модификатор considerably правильно усиливает сравнительную степень easier and faster, тогда как very и more much здесь ошибочны.

prompt: Ainhoa said the fifth-grade trays were very cleaner than all the others.
answer: Ainhoa said the fifth-grade trays were much cleaner than all the others.
accepted_answers: Ainhoa said the fifth-grade trays were much cleaner than all the others.
Ainhoa said the fifth-grade trays were far cleaner than all the others.
Ainhoa said the fifth-grade trays were a lot cleaner than all the others.
explanation_ru: Слово very не употребляется со сравнительной степенью; вместо very cleaner нужно использовать much/far/a lot cleaner.

prompt: Beatriz reported that the evening brass band drew by far the bigger dancing crowd the square had welcomed in twenty years.
answer: Beatriz reported that the evening brass band drew by far the biggest dancing crowd the square had welcomed in twenty years.
accepted_answers: Beatriz reported that the evening brass band drew by far the biggest dancing crowd the square had welcomed in twenty years.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о рекорде за двадцать лет, поэтому после by far нужна превосходная степень the biggest, а не сравнительная the bigger.

prompt: Diane told us that this autumn's blood drive attracted easily the highest number of first-time donors we have ever had.
answer: Diane told us that this autumn's blood drive attracted easily the highest number of first-time donors we have ever had.
accepted_answers: Diane told us that this autumn's blood drive attracted easily the highest number of first-time donors we have ever had.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: усилитель easily стоит перед превосходной степенью the highest, что идеально подходит для рекорда.

prompt: Imran posted a cheerful notice saying our new van loader sorted the morning parcel routes more much quickly than anyone else during his trial week.
answer: Imran posted a cheerful notice saying our new van loader sorted the morning parcel routes much more quickly than anyone else during his trial week.
accepted_answers: Imran posted a cheerful notice saying our new van loader sorted the morning parcel routes much more quickly than anyone else during his trial week.
explanation_ru: Нарушен порядок слов: усилитель much всегда ставится перед more, образуя связку much more quickly, а не more much quickly.

prompt: Mark's sunflower is huge. Only one indoor sunflower in Britain is taller.
options: Mark's sunflower is by far the tallest in Britain.
Mark's sunflower is the second-tallest indoor one in Britain.
Mark's sunflower is slightly taller than the tallest one.
Mark's sunflower is much shorter than every other one.
explanation_ru: Если выше только один подсолнух, значит подсолнух Клайва занимает второе место — the second-tallest.

prompt: Tuula coached a teenage skier who raced uphill on borrowed wooden skis. She beat the second-place skier by less than half a second, shocking the crowd.
options: She climbed the hill by far the slowest of the county racers.
She finished much faster than the second-place skier on the uphill lap.
She reached the top slightly faster than the runner-up despite her borrowed skis.
She completed the race easily the worst of anyone in the winter cup.
explanation_ru: Отрыв менее полсекунды означает совсем небольшую разницу, поэтому подходит модификатор slightly, а не much.

prompt: No other breakfast stall on the plaza is nearly as busy as this corn-cake cart. → This corn-cake cart is by far …
answer: This corn-cake cart is by far the busiest breakfast stall on the plaza.
accepted_answers: This corn-cake cart is by far the busiest breakfast stall on the plaza.
This corn-cake cart is by far the busiest stall on the plaza.
This corn-cake cart is by far the busiest on the plaza.
explanation_ru: Выражение «ни один другой киоск даже близко не такой оживлённый» равнозначно усиленной превосходной степени by far the busiest.

prompt: Heiko's annual report shows the other city lines didn't arrive nearly as reliably as the riverside tram. → According to Heiko's annual report, the riverside tram arrived much …
answer: According to Heiko's annual report, the riverside tram arrived much more reliably than the other city lines.
accepted_answers: According to Heiko's annual report, the riverside tram arrived much more reliably than the other city lines.
According to Heiko's annual report, the riverside tram arrived much more reliably than the other lines.
explanation_ru: Отрицание с nearly as reliably as при перефразировании в утверждение переходит в усиленную сравнительную степень наречия much more reliably than.
